speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; please tell me what symptoms you are experiencing right now and how long you have noticed them. text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, combined with your history of ataxia, confirm this diagnosis, likely secondary to an underlying immunocompromised state such as HIV or chemotherapy.
